other_conditions: Applicant must be an artist who is in indigent condition
Applicant must have contributed to or worked in the field of Art and culture
Income ceiling of ₹48,000 per annum does not apply if the applicant is a recipient of the State Cultural Award
Number of cases sanctioned depends on fund availability each financial year
benefits_summary: Monthly financial assistance of ₹2,500, increased to ₹3,200 for State Cultural Award recipients, payable each year.
